thread:
nina_ux: Quick design review note: the in-console help cards on the Models dashboard use the label "Help" while the docs site and tooltips use "Docs". In user testing people hesitated because the iconography suggests the same thing but the wording differs.
leo_pm: Saw the same in the usability session. People clicked "Help" expecting the deep-linked docs section but got a modal with short tips. We should align or clearly distinguish actions.
omar_frontend: Current state: two components- `InlineHelpCard` uses textContent = 'Help' from i18n key help.card.title, and `DocsPanel` uses 'Docs'. They diverged during a refactor. Code change simple, but need copy decision.
tess_docs: My preference: canonicalize on "Docs" for all entry points and make "Help" a distinct microcopy for troubleshooting tips within the panel. I can update docs headings and add stable ids.
ada_a11y: Important: if we rename UI labels, ensure aria labels include the doc id, e.g., aria-describedby="docs-desc-execution". Also ensure triggers include aria-expanded and aria-controls. When opening via external link (e.g., /models?help=quantization or /models#quantization) the overlay must be announced and focus moved to the heading.
omar_frontend: Implementation plan: 1) rename i18n key to docs.card.title = 'Docs', create help.card.subtitle for micro tips; 2) add data-doc-id attr to triggers; 3) on open, if data-doc-id present call history.pushState(null,'',`#${id}`) and focus the section inside overlay; 4) support parsing ?help= and # anchors on initial load. I estimate 1d dev + 0.5d a11y + docs PR.
tess_docs: I'll add stable ids on the docs site (e.g., id="quantization") and a mapping file docs/aliases.json that maps UI labels -> anchors so we can generate the in-product snippets automatically.
ada_a11y: QA checklist: keyboard-only flow, NVDA/VoiceOver announcement, focus trap, visible focus ring, and back button returns focus to triggering element. Also regression test for screen reader users who navigated directly with fragments.
leo_pm: Priority: P2. Please include a short copy guideline in the PR describing when to use "Docs" vs "Help" and how to surface API verb equivalences (e.g., Run vs Execute).
ci-bot: CI queued: frontend change and docs PR need to land together or we'll add redirect rules for anchors.
nina_ux: One small UX idea: when the overlay opens from a deep link, show a faint banner "Opened Docs from link" with an affordance to collapse, so users know why it appeared. Optional.
omar_frontend: Will include banner as optional flag behind feature toggle. Will tag UX and Docs on PR.
tess_docs: I'll prepare alias table and a small redirect map for legacy anchors.
leo_pm: Great sync. I'll create a ticket with acceptance criteria: unified label = 'Docs', anchors + ?help= support, aria attributes + focus behavior, docs alias table updated. Assign to omar_frontend and tess_docs. Thanks all.
